landing.title: Reports
landing.subtitle: Turn deterministic CRM figures into a review-ready narrative with charts, recommendations, an appendix, and traceable sources.
landing.templatesSubtitle: Every template includes a grounded narrative and can be tailored before it is shared.
landing.savedSubtitle: Shared report definitions available to this workspace.
landing.emptyBody: Choose a template above or start with a blank report to create the first one.

pipeline-health.name: Pipeline Health

forecasting.name: Forecasting

quota-attainment.name: Quota Attainment
quota-attainment.description: Owner and workspace revenue targets compared with won revenue.

relationship-health.name: Relationship Health
relationship-health.description: Cooling accounts, coverage gaps, and single-threaded deal risk.

builder.subtitle: Choose the evidence, shape the canvas, and let the narrative stay grounded in the resulting figures.
builder.name: Name
builder.descriptionPlaceholder: What should this report help the team decide?
builder.filtersSubtitle: These filters apply to every evidence block in the report.
builder.attainmentFilters: Attainment uses the full quota scope. Pipeline, status, and tag filters are unavailable; owner filters are available only without a workspace-wide attainment block.

builder.nameRequired: Give the report a name before saving.
builder.rangeRequired: Custom reports require both a start and end date.
builder.dragInstructions: Press space to lift an evidence block, use arrow keys to move it, and press space to drop.
